recommendations: Do not infer entity identity from the host of a press release.
Require separately evidenced agency founding, predecessor, rebranding and registration dates.
Do not default all new agency revenue models to wire subscriptions.
Store direct source asset URL, retrieval date, role, source entity and variant validity separately from legal reuse assertions.
A successfully decoded logo and a caption matching its text are not independent authenticity checks.
